title: Single zone systems.
officialText:
Where one air handler supplies a mixture of outdoor air and recirculated retu rn air to only one
zone, the system outdoor air intake flow rate (V ) shall be determined in accordance with Equation 4-3.
ot
V = V (Equation 4-3)
